answer: Auction only 100 new identity slots per epoch on one island market, throttling the tide of newcomers. At 3,000 POA per slot, an attacker wanting 1,000 fake identities must pay 3,000,000 POA and wait at least ten epochs, while an honest agent pays 3,000 POA once. If audit links two slots to one operator, both slots are revoked, both payments are burned, the operator is banned ten epochs, and the reporter gains a free slot. The rule is fixed like a sonnet, with no extra verses. Limitation: a wealthy attacker can still outbid honest newcomers, so the auction caps scale but not wealth bias.
